test_case.purpose: Verify every jumper reference designated by the approved motherboard layout is physically present at the correct PCB location, without evaluating or changing each shunt's electrical setting, which is separately covered by the next source case.
required_package: Expected coordinate/orientation and allowed unpopulated/DNI headers
Safe inspection power/chassis/ESD procedure and photo coverage
test_case.test_command: Bind SUT to motherboard assembly/PCB revision and full jumper location map; use approved powered-down/ESD inspection; qualified operator captures an overview and labeled close-up for every required reference designator/coordinate, noting missing, extra, inaccessible or mismarked headers; compare population and location only; do not touch shunts or infer setting.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Make sure Jumoer location is correct.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact Location Check identity and as-found evidence to match the signed product/board/SKU specification: `1. Make sure Jumoer location is correct.`. Missing revision, designator, mapping or visual evidence blocks execution; no position change, reseat or actuation is authorized by this inspection.
safety_gate: Match exact PCB revision before using layout map
Do not remove, reposition or electrically probe shunts
Stop on ambiguous/missing labels, unsafe access or suspected disturbance
expected_evidence: Annotated overview and indexed close-up photos
test_case.recovery: Keep this row location/population-only and use row 2285 for required shunt settings; combining them must not allow one evidence set to omit either scope.
